examples.arabic: بكل زاوية من الشوارع المهجورة، كانت ذكريات القذائف بتلاحق الناس، بس ريحة الخبز الطازة كانت بتعطيهم أمل مخبى.
examples.english: In every corner of the abandoned streets, memories of the shells were haunting the people, but the smell of fresh bread was giving them a hidden hope.
examples.transliteration: Bi-kull zawiya min al-shawari al-mahjoura, kanat dhikrayat al-qadha'if bit-lahiq al-nas, bass rihat al-khubz al-taza kanat bit-atihom amal mkhabba.
examples.storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

examples.arabic: ريحة الزعتر السخن والخبز الطازة بتعبي شارع الجميزة الساعة سبعة الصبح.
examples.english: The smell of hot thyme and fresh bread fills Gemmayzeh street at seven in the morning.
examples.transliteration: Rihat el zaatar el sukhun wa el khubz el taza bitabbi sharie Gemmayzeh el saa sabaa el subh.

examples.arabic: كنت عم بمشي بالسوق القديم وشميت ريحة قهوة طازة
examples.english: I was walking in the old market and smelled fresh coffee.
examples.transliteration: Kunt 'am bamshi bi-s-souq el-qadeem w shammeit reehet qahwe taza

examples.arabic: بشتري بندورة وخيار طازة من البائع اللي بعرفه من زمان
examples.english: I buy fresh tomatoes and cucumbers from the seller I've known for a long time.
examples.transliteration: Bashtarī banadūra w khiyār ṭāza min el-bā'e' elli ba'rafo min zamān.
examples.storyTitle: A Morning Trip to the Market

examples.arabic: اشتريت خضرا طازة وريحتها كانت كتير حلوة
examples.english: I bought fresh vegetables and their smell was very nice.
examples.transliteration: Ishtarayt khadra taza w rihet-ha kanat ktir helwe.

examples.arabic: كنت ماشي بالشوارع القديمة وشميت ريحة خبز طازة كتير حلوة
examples.english: I was walking in the old streets and smelled the very nice fresh bread.
examples.transliteration: Kunt mashe bel shawarea el qadeeme w shammayt reehet khubez taze kteer helwe.
